releases.title: Version 1.0
releases.summary: Segue's first public release on the Mac App Store.

highlights.text: Paste a chord sheet from a website and on-device AI checks its sections and title; nothing you paste leaves your Mac.
Drag in ChordPro, text and .crd files, then fill each song's card: artists, Movie / Album, key, tempo, capo and tags.
Build a set by ticking songs in order or typing a request, with per-show key and capo, breaks and running totals.
Arrange a song for one gig, or join songs into a medley, each in its own key, with a written transition.
A stage view that fits every song on one screen, with a visual metronome on stage and a click in rehearsals.
Singer view: lyrics only, on stage with V or on a second display for the singer.
Print a song, or the whole set as a songbook PDF that looks like the stage, with chords, bass notes or lyrics only.
Bass notes, walk-ups and fills, and a play-along of bass, chords and click when you rehearse.
